reviews.x: I use my Frownies every night since I'm 35 around my mouth and between my brows. I'm a side sleeper so whatever other procedure I'm getting won't prevent me from wrinkles around my mouth . Only Frownies helps with that. I tried several other plastic patches but all of them left me with a loss of my skin color when I pulled them off. That's never happened with Frownies. Ahyhow, I can't live without them .Thank you for making them.

reviews.t: Effective on lines and under the eye bags
reviews.x: Quite honestly, I don't understand the negative comments. I'm 61 and have used various forms of facial taping for about 6 years. Both all the dental technicians I see and my MD comment on how wrinkle-free my face is.  I started using Frownies because they also do a good job of preventing the under-eye bags I was starting to get. The other reviewers seemed to reject the product without even having tried it. Yet, it does feel a little weird but it works.
I was a little suspect of these, but after my dermatologist suggested them, I purchased. Easy to use, good results.

reviews.t: These really helped my sleep lines
reviews.x: I sleep on my side and stomach with my face smooshed in the pillow which is terrible for creating sleep lines. Every morning I wake up with these lines under both my eyes (top left pic) and they don’t really smooth out during the day. These can not be fixed with Botox and I can’t make myself sleep on my back all night so these are the next best thing. I trim the point off and use them as shown in the picture. I wish there was a better fit for under the eye but I’m making it work. They stay on pr

Honestly how can these possibly have good reviews? They are utterly useless. Feel like pieces of cardboard and then you have to stick them to your face .. what .. even when moisturized (the right side) they feel and look a little Frankenstein-ness. How stupid .. feel like returning, probably will.

These aren’t a immediate fix, but with consistent use I’ve had amazing result with my 11 lines that were starting to form and my forehead wrinkles. I’m 30 and didn’t want to do Botox yet. I’ve been using since January this year and it’s now June and I look younger than I did in my 20’s. I love how the vegetable glycerine that’s used at the adhesive leaves my skin feeling so smooth. I would assume the earlier you start using these the better the results will be but I’ve seen more mature faces hav
Actually used to prevent grinding of teeth at night. Prevents the tension tied to the frown.
I have used frownies for about eight years.  They have prevented wrinkles on my forehead I would have due to the way I scrunch my face when I sleep.  I am 39 and have no forehead wrinkles.
The latest box that I received were not genuine Frownies. Very disappointing

reviews.t: Read the instructions, learn how the patches work.
reviews.x: READ THE INSTRUCTIONS THAT COME WITH THE PATCHES. A lot of people in these reviews seem confused. Most of the negative reviews are from people who did not read the instructions and/or don’t understand how these patches work. These patches work by retraining facial muscles throughout the night. It’s highly recommended to sleep in them. Yes, they do stiffen. That’s the whole purpose. They are not an immediate fix. You’ll see a difference almost immediately, but it won’t last very long. reviews.x: I received theses followed directions! It hurt so bad to take them off there hard paper sticky glue you litterly have to peel them off your face left the areas raw! Had to use NEOSPORIN to areas of chaffing! im really diaapointed with this product have not received the other package ,butt i will be sending them back not worth the money i payed for it to feel like it was ripping my skin. The face has Delicate skin . I will never use theses again ever

reviews.t: Used correctly they are a great alternative to invasive procedures
reviews.x: You must use them correctly- they DO work, I have used for years.  They are like stamps- you must wet and then hold in place for a bit until they dry.  They are a one time use product.
No good. It is just brown paper with adhesive and it did not stay on.

reviews.t: Works for what is intended. Uncomfortable to sleep in.
reviews.x: These actually work great for smoothing out wrinkles but it doesn't last through the day. Also, they are so uncomfortable to sleep in and not super easy to remove. I only used them for a few nights and then never again.
Have used this product for several years. This order was received exactly as I expected it to be. Thanks.

reviews.t: Love these but read the directions!
reviews.x: These are so great as I expected. I’ve been using the forehead patches for a year or so now. I bought these and was not disappointed. The directions say to remove in the shower however I’m a night shower girl. The first time I got the patches a little damp but pulled skin off and had a scab for a few days. I get them drenched before I even attempt to take them off. You have to let the smile line patches dry completely before laying down or they will fall off very quickly.

I’m trying Frownies for the naso-labial lines, hoping to prevent and soften. I don’t need them for my eyes  The problem is, they STINK.  They are right there by my nose and I really really hate how they smell. Ugh. It’s like pigs feet or something. They just smell nasty. I’m honestly to a point where I may not care if they work. They smell so gross.

So far so good! Just woke up after the first morning of using it and I notice a dramatic difference. I know it’ll probably fade throughout the day, and consistency is key. But I was happy to see these results after one use because I was a little skeptical. It did hurt a little while taking it off, but not so bad to where I wouldn’t keep using it.
I did not expect these to be little paper pieces with an adhesive like a stamp. The adhesive has a weird smell and they fall off pretty easy. Very Disappointed.
Saw this on TikTok and absolutely love this!!! I had fine lines around my mouth and I kid u not after just one over night use they were gone!

I am a side sleeper and began noticing lines coming down the middle of my eyebrows.  Every morning I treated the lines with a cream and that helped.  Was doing some research and found Frownies.  Thought "what the heck" and tried a box.  They do look freakish but they work.  I cut one in two and place just above the eyebrow where the creases appear and no more creases.  They are not cheap but it's worth the price not to have the lines thru my eyebrows every morning.

Well these have created a red,bumpy, itchy, painful rash in the exact place I put the frownie. This photo is 48 hours after the initial rash And I discontinue use of the patches immediately. The smell of the patches is really bad and I should’ve taken that as a sign not to put it on my face but now here we are and make up on even cover it and I pride myself on having extremely clear skin I hope the rash goes away it’s really uncomfortable and very unsightly.

I had high hopes for the product, seems like a great idea especially as a side sleeper. However, I can save you $24 by advising you purchase stamps and placing them on your face. I in no way expected to receive a box of cardboard paper stamps for my face. The adhesion was horrendous (didn’t stick). Felt like if does more damage to the skin than good. Please do not buy.

Save your money, and your skin. This is essentially brown packaging tape. It goes on with difficulty, curls and hardens when dry and creates strange contours in your face. The corners are sharp and scratchy. It KILLS to remove, I thought my skin would rip off with it. Extremely uncomfortable to sleep in. JUNK.

I have purchased both Frownies and it's competitor, Smoothies. Frownies had the better results out of the two products. If you want to reverse your age lines permenately, use Frownies. If you want ease of use and comfort, choose Smoothies, however, the results are not long lasting or for deep set wrinkles.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the patches effectively reduce or prevent wrinkles and sleep lines, especially with consistent use.
Several reviewers say the patches are uncomfortable to wear and painful or difficult to remove, sometimes leaving skin raw.
Some reviewers report the patches did not stay on or were useless, and one received what they believed were counterfeit patches.
A few reviewers emphasize that following the instructions is essential and that negative experiences often stem from incorrect use.
Some long-term users praise the product as a reliable, non-invasive alternative they have repurchased for years.
